prompt: I'm building a project management tool with oRPC. Design the API surface for `Project` (belongs to a `Workspace`) and `Task` (belongs to a `Project`). Each task has a status (todo/in-progress/blocked/done) and a priority (low/medium/high). I want to be able to list, fetch, create, update, and delete both. Show me the Zod schemas and oRPC procedures with HTTP routes. Don't bother implementing the handlers — leave them as stubs.

assertions.text: Project path uses hierarchical pattern workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project}
Collection identifiers (workspaces, projects, tasks) are lowercase plural camelCase
Update procedure uses HTTP PATCH (not PUT)
List input uses pageSize/pageToken cursor pagination (not offset/limit)
Status enum has a *_UNSPECIFIED zero-value member
Priority enum has a *_UNSPECIFIED zero-value member
Enum members use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g. IN_PROGRESS, not in-progress)
Project and Task schemas expose a `name: string` field as canonical identifier
Task does NOT embed Project as a nested object (references by name string instead)
Update input supports partial fields + updateMask (not full resource replace)
List/create inputs include a `parent` string field for the parent resource
